title: The interior-product operator v ↦ ι(v) = v♭ ∧ · from ℝ^P to L(Λ^m, Λ^{m+1}) is (m+1)-Lipschitz
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ. For v ∈ ℝ^P let ι(v) := (alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ ℝ^P ℝ) ∘ (smulRightL ℝ ℝ^P Λ^m (innerSL ℝ v)) : Λ^m → Λ^{m+1}, where Λ^k := Covector (Eucl P) k is the space of continuous alternating k-forms on ℝ^P (so ι(v)α = v♭∧α, (ι(v)α)(v₀,…,v_m) = Σ_i (−1)^i ⟨v, v_i⟩ α(v₀,…,v̂_i,…,v_m)). Then the map v ↦ ι(v), from ℝ^P to the space of continuous linear maps Λ^m → Λ^{m+1} with the operator norm, is Lipschitz with constant m + 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), LipschitzWith ((m : ℝ≥0) + 1) (fun v : Eucl P => (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ v)))
